context: A police officer briefs a manager about industrial safety
purpose: Teach: 山下/バグ/フィルター/耐久/清掃/日数/リットル/アナログ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の山下工場、耐久基準の見直しを推奨します。
lines.en: I recommend reviewing your endurance standards at the Yamashita plant.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Even pace, no rush. Slight pause before the plant name—specific, documented. The tone of someone who has seen this before and is not alarmed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。アナログ系の老朽化、バグの温床です。
lines.en: Yes. The old analog systems are deteriorating—they're breeding grounds for problems.
lines.style: Acknowledging, slightly resigned. Small breath before the dash. Cooperative tone but honest about the scope. He's not deflecting, just being direct with his superior.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 清掃と点検、リットル単位の漏洩管理が必要です。
lines.en: Cleaning, inspection, and precise leak management down to the liter. It's critical.
lines.style: Steady, procedural authority. Each item lands clearly. Slight emphasis on precision—this is not approximate work. Professional but not cold; he's seen what happens when this slips.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: フィルター系の見直し、残り日数で対応します。
lines.en: Filter review and system overhaul—we'll get it done before time runs out.
lines.style: Quick, competent reassurance. Slight forward lean in the voice. He's committing, not hedging. Practical, no flourish—just: we can do this.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Quiet, weight behind it. Brief. Not informal, but human—one professional to another. The kind of request that's also a recognition.
